method: Every public snapshot and HLS master requested once with four workers and 20-second timeout. JPEG structure and known official placeholders checked. Source Last-Modified over one hour is marked stale. HLS syntax and CORS checked. One child playlist and MPEG-TS segment sampled per successful host; not every stream was played. No recording. Stale/placeholder and small-frame candidates rechecked with the browser refresh query; suspicious small/duplicate frames visually reviewed.
